text:
Oh, it's you again.
Do you need something?
zh:
哦，又是你。
你需要点什么吗？

text: I was about to get a drink and a warm stew. Out of nowhere, I had an idea.
zh: 我本来只想喝一杯，再来碗热炖菜。突然间，我冒出了个主意。

text: Why shouldn't Rair and I work together?
zh: 我和莱尔为什么不合伙干呢？

text:
Long story short, I sell booze and Rair's stew now on my way through Grenmark.
In return, Rair gets a small cut of the profits.
zh:
长话短说，现在我一边走遍格伦马克，一边卖酒和莱尔的炖菜。
作为回报，莱尔从利润里抽一小成。

text:
Well... Are you thirsty?
I have some good stuff to sell.
zh:
怎么样……渴了吗？
我这儿有些好货要卖。
